ruleDefinitions.name: New Network Trace Capture Started Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of netsh with the "trace" flag in order to start a network capture

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*trace.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*")))
